confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Kaohsiung and Taiwan price levels for July 2026. No live booking pages, menus, or current listings were inspected. Accommodation and bar prices carry the most uncertainty and vary with summer demand and neighborhood. Restaurant anchors are more reliable. Beer, cocktail, and wine are set from typical Taiwanese relationships. The FX value comes from the RBA exchange-rates overview page as surfaced in search results; the full F11.1 daily table was not retrieved.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Taiwan's mid-sized southern cities (Tainan, Taichung) with Kaohsiung priced modestly below Taipei for restaurants and lodging. Beer, cocktail, and wine were scaled from the local beer price using typical Taiwanese restaurant and bar markups.
